basis: Isolated glycerol metabolism defect includes asymptomatic adults; supplied adrenal/myopathy and neurologic HPO appears conflated with complex Xp21 deletion disease.

decisions.neurologic: none: annotated 80-99% neurologic findings appear conflated with complex GKD; lasting neurologic damage in >=30% of isolated GKD is not established.

basis: BH4 synthesis deficiency is a metabolic disorder whose clinical spectrum is defined by central neurotransmitter deficiency, dystonia and encephalopathy.

decisions.neurologic: primary: dystonia and encephalopathy from central neurotransmitter deficiency define the clinical disease spectrum.

basis: Immune dysregulation directly causes dermatitis in 15/16, inflammatory airway disease in 11/16 and gastrointestinal eosinophilic infiltration in 10/16.

decisions.dermatologic: involved: intrinsic atopic dermatitis affects 15/16 (94%); it is a common tissue manifestation of the underlying immune disorder.

basis: Skeletal dysplasia with valve disease, airway obstruction and thickened stiff skin, each 30-79%; conductive hearing impairment (30-79%) omitted at the four-axis cap.

decisions.dermatologic: involved: characteristic thickened, stiff skin is frequent (30-79%); retained with severe valve and airway disease under the cap.
decisions.otologic: none: conductive hearing impairment qualifies at 30-79% but is omitted at the cap, prioritizing characteristic skin disease and severe valve/airway disease.

basis: Mitochondrial translation disorder causes acute hepatic failure; prolonged PT (8/8) reflects hepatic synthetic failure. Low IgG alone does not establish immunodeficiency.

decisions.haematologic: none: prolonged PT in 8/8 results from hepatic clotting-factor synthesis failure, without direct blood or marrow disease.

basis: Spirillum minus infection characteristically causes recurrent inflammation and ulceration at the bite site (>30%); this is tissue injury, unlike the transient systemic rash.

decisions.dermatologic: involved: recurrent bite-site inflammation and ulceration are characteristic and common (>30%); ulceration is direct skin injury, independent of transient rash.

basis: Congenital portal-systemic venous communication; altered hepatic perfusion alone is not liver injury. Liver atrophy and neurologic/pulmonary injury lack an established >=30% frequency.

decisions.hepatic: none: the defining lesion is venous; diversion of portal flow alone is not hepatic damage, and liver atrophy in >=30% across the umbrella is not established.

basis: Vitreoretinal disease; interstitial lung abnormalities and enamel hypoplasia each 2/2; encephalocele and developmental impairment 1/2. PDA (1/2) omitted at cap; tiny sample.

decisions.neurologic: involved: encephalocele, seizures and developmental impairment occur in 1/2 (50%); these support associated CNS injury rather than a universal defining feature.

basis: Progressive sensory and motor neuron degeneration; muscle atrophy (80-99%) is secondary to denervation, and dysphagia reflects bulbar dysfunction rather than gastrointestinal injury.

decisions.musculoskeletal: none: atrophy in 80-99% reflects motor-neuron denervation; the disease process directly affects neurons rather than skeletal muscle.

basis: Chromosomal rearrangement with no axis-specific phenotype documented; no organ injury can be inferred from the inversion alone.

decisions.neurologic: none: no neurologic phenotype, diagnostic criterion or organ-specific evidence is supplied; the chromosome inversion alone cannot establish neurologic damage.
